text:
Noah Bennett: Heads up from support: multiple tenants hit 400s after upgrading api-client. They sent X-API-Version: 2026-04 and our gateway rejected. We need a non-invasive shim for a while.
Aisha Rahman: We always debated having a permissive path. Suggest a middleware 'version-tolerator' that maps unknown versions to 'compat:v1' and adds X-Compat-Used: true. Return Warning header to be safe.
Lena Park: Important: we must avoid silent data mutation. The shim should not mutate request payloads; it only controls routing and feature flags. If server-side conversion required, return 422 with details.
Noah Bennett: Proposed minimal behavior:
1) Unknown X-API-Version -> attach header X-Compat-Probe:1 and forward to compat-router.
2) compat-router runs schema compatibility checks; if incompatible -> 422 + X-Compat-Error: field_missing
3) If compatible, process normally but include Warning: 299 CompatFellback and X-Compat-Used:true
Aisha Rahman: For observability track compat_probe_count, compat_success_count, compat_error_types, and per-tenant latency delta. Also add a histogram of time spent in compatibility checks.
Lena Park: Rollout plan: FF controlled at gateway; canary to 1% for 6h, then 10% for 24h. Provide tenants ability to opt-out via tenant settings.
ops-bot: alert-engine: scheduled canary at 1715382000 with perc=1%
Noah Bennett: SDKs: let's avoid breaking SDK behavior. Add opt-in flag in JS & Python SDKs to set X-Compat-Opt header. Also change default SDK behavior to log a console warning rather than throwing.
Aisha Rahman: Tests: unit tests for middleware, integration with compat-router, synthetic tenants sending unknown versions, and a performance test under peak load to ensure no latency cliffs.
Lena Park: Action items: Aisha implement gateway middleware + FF (due Tue). Noah open SDK PRs to add opt-in and warning (due Tue). I'll attach a short runbook for rollback criteria: >0.5% request error increase OR 20% latency p95 regression -> immediate FF off.
Noah Bennett: final note: be conservative, feature-flag everything, and favour observability over magic. We'll re-evaluate after two weeks.
